$schema.description: Schema is the optional "$schema" reference; ignored.

listen.description: Listen is the gateway listen address, default ":8080".

publicUrl.description:
PublicURL is used for cookies, OIDC redirects and Origin checks;
default "http://localhost:8080".

dataDir.description:
DataDir holds the SQLite database, the local progress file, the
curriculum cache and the cookie secret; default "/data".

mode.description: Mode is none (local only, default), invite or oidc.

file.description:
File has one code per line with optional label, uses=N and
until=YYYY-MM-DD (deploy/invites.example.txt).

allowedEmailDomains.description: AllowedEmailDomains restricts logins; empty allows any.

cookieSecretFile.description:
CookieSecretFile holds the HMAC key; generated on first start if
missing; default "<dataDir>/cookie.secret".

sessionDays.description: SessionDays is the cookie lifetime, default 30.

backend.description:
Backend is static (default in local mode) or docker (default in server
mode).

dockerHost.description:
DockerHost is the Engine API endpoint, normally the socket proxy
("tcp://socket-proxy:2375"); empty uses DOCKER_HOST.

network.description:
Network is the Docker network shared by session containers with
isolation shared.

isolation.description:
Isolation is network (default): every session gets its own internal
network pg-net-<id> that the gateway joins, so sessions cannot reach
each other; or shared: all sessions join Network.

subnetPool.description:
SubnetPool is the IPv4 range session networks take their /28 subnets
from, default "10.231.0.0/16" (4096 sessions). Empty lets the Docker
daemon choose from its default-address-pools, which hold about 30
networks unless configured.

gatewayContainer.description:
GatewayContainer is the gateway's own container (name or id), which
joins every session network; default the gateway's hostname, which
Docker sets to the container id.

memory.description: Memory, default "3g" (Docker size syntax: b, k, m, g).

disk.description:
Disk is a volume size hint, default "4g"; enforced only on storage
drivers with quotas.

idleStopMinutes.description:
IdleStopMinutes stops a session with no WebSocket for this long,
default 30.

maxSessions.description: MaxSessions refuses new sessions beyond this, default 50.

volumeRetentionDays.description:
VolumeRetentionDays removes workspace volumes unused for this long,
default 30.

egress.description: Egress is none, registries (default) or all.

enabled.description: Enabled provisions an SSH box per learner, default true.
Enabled makes the GUI frame available, default true.

geometry.description: Geometry is the Xvnc screen size, default "1600x900".

initialSize.description:
InitialSize is "COLSxROWS" until the browser resizes, default
"120x36".

sessionUrl.description:
SessionURL is the fixed session's sessiond, default
"http://session:7000".

workspace.description: Workspace is documented for the Makefile; Compose mounts it.

sessionId.description:
SessionID is the fixed session's id (PG_SESSION_ID of the session
container), default "local". Extension over deployment.md §3.

sessionToken.description:
SessionToken is the fixed session's bearer token for /internal
(PG_SESSION_TOKEN of the session container), default "local".
Extension over deployment.md §3.

dir.description:
Dir holds curriculum.json, lesson bundles and fixture tarballs,
default "/srv/curriculum".

level.description: Level is debug, info (default), warn or error.

stuckReports.description: StuckReports allows "I'm stuck" reports, default true.

telemetryUpload.description: TelemetryUpload is never on by default.

authorMode.description:
AuthorMode shows condition results and raw state in lessons and
enables rpc eval through the gateway, default false.
